title: Visitors appear when Anne's chosen groups come to the cabin

tellings.quote: And when she would get these groups up at the cabin, the visitors would show up.

plain: The writer Whitley Strieber, who says he has met beings he calls "the visitors", tells Michels that when his wife, Anne Strieber, brought groups of people up to their cabin in upstate New York, from the late 1980s through the 1990s, the visitors would show up. He tells it as something he saw himself, and if true it would mean the beings appeared on cue for people Anne had chosen.
